snippet.title: HopScout Trailer - A cozy logic puzzle game by Studio Doodal
snippet.description:
HopScout is a cozy logic puzzle game about arranging cute, picky rabbits to keep everyone happy. Take your time solving puzzles, help the rabbit burrow overcome a looming crisis, and discover the heartwarming stories of its adorable residents.

Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4952260/
